text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Teacher
text_block_list.text:
B-Believe-san...? What on earth is that 
wood carving...?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
――? It's the Three Goddesses statue. I'm 
making it while looking at the real 
thing...

text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Wait, the Three Goddesses... There are 
five of them, you know? And one of them... 
has three faces and six arms.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A bizarre creation... Believe is utterly 
exhausted from her packed schedule. It 
might be wise to reconsider her race 
pacing.
